section: Iterate — change: bump pinned GitHub Actions
title: Move five pinned GitHub Actions to their current major versions
context: Dependabot opened #195-#199 for new majors of checkout, setup-node, upload-artifact, create-or-update-comment and lcov-reporter-action. They are mainly Node 24 runtime moves.
decision: Apply all five as one change. Keep each pin on a full SHA independently resolved from its release tag. Dispatch the manual-only CodeQL and security workflows on the branch to exercise them.
consequences: CI actions run on supported runtimes. The PR-comment action stays unexercised until the security workflow's pull_request trigger is enabled.
rationale: The changes are mechanical, and none of the breaking changes affect how these workflows use the actions. One review covers all five instead of five PRs.
rejected: Merging the five Dependabot PRs separately: five CI cycles and five reviews of the same kind of change.
